description.en: Timur took control of Transoxiana in 1370 and led armies from Delhi to Anatolia. After his death in 1405, his descendants ruled Khurasan and Transoxiana from Herat and Samarkand and patronised scholars and artists, until Shaybani Khan took Herat in 1507.
description.es: Timur tomó el control de Transoxiana en 1370 y dirigió ejércitos desde Delhi hasta Anatolia. Tras su muerte en 1405, sus descendientes gobernaron Jorasán y Transoxiana desde Herat y Samarcanda y protegieron a sabios y artistas, hasta que Shaybani Jan tomó Herat en 1507.
description.zh: 帖木儿于1370年掌控河中地区，率军从德里一直打到安纳托利亚。他于1405年去世后，后代以赫拉特和撒马尔罕为中心统治呼罗珊和河中地区，资助学者与艺术家，直到1507年昔班尼汗攻占赫拉特。

sources.citation: British Museum collection thesaurus, "Timurid dynasty" (1370–1507), via PeriodO.
World History Encyclopedia, "Timur": Timur took control of Transoxiana in 1370.
Wikidata, "Timurid Empire" (Q484195): start 1370, end 1507.
EBSCO Research Starters, "Timurid Dynasty": the Shaybani Uzbeks brought the Timurid Empire to a close in 1507.

title.en: Timur takes sole control of Transoxiana and makes Samarkand his capital
title.es: Timur toma el control único de Transoxiana y hace de Samarcanda su capital
title.zh: 帖木儿独掌河中地区，并以撒马尔罕为都城

sources.citation: World History Encyclopedia, "Timur": founder of the Timurid Empire (1370-1507), with its capital at Samarkand.
EBSCO Research Starters, "Tamerlane": at Balkh in 1370 he took the throne of Central Asia; Samarqand his capital.
Encyclopedia.com, "Timur": Husayn captured and executed at Balkh in 1370; Tamerlane builds up Samarkand.

title.en: Timur's army sacks Delhi, the capital of the Tughluq sultans
title.es: El ejército de Timur saquea Delhi, la capital de los sultanes tughluq
title.zh: 帖木儿的军队洗劫图格鲁克苏丹的都城德里

sources.citation: World History Encyclopedia, "Timur": invaded the Delhi Sultanate in the winter of 1398-99 and sacked Delhi.
World History Encyclopedia, "Tughlaq Dynasty": the sack of Delhi by Timur in 1398 was the dynasty's last blow.
Encyclopedia.com, "Timur": burned and looted Delhi in 1398.

title.en: Timur sacks Baghdad and kills many of its inhabitants
title.es: Timur saquea Bagdad y mata a muchos de sus habitantes
title.zh: 帖木儿洗劫巴格达，杀害大批居民

sources.citation: U.S. Library of Congress Country Studies, "Iraq: The Mongol Invasion": in 1401 Tamerlane sacked Baghdad and massacred many of its inhabitants.
World History Encyclopedia, "Timur": Baghdad sacked in 1401.
EBSCO Research Starters, "Tamerlane": campaigns into Baghdad and Damascus in 1401.

title.en: Timur defeats the Ottoman sultan Bayezid I at Ankara and takes him prisoner
title.es: Timur derrota al sultán otomano Bayezid I en Ankara y lo toma prisionero
title.zh: 帖木儿在安卡拉击败奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世并将其俘虏

sources.citation: World History Encyclopedia, "Timur": the Battle of Ankara, 28 July 1402, a victory for Timur over Bayezid I.
EBSCO Research Starters, "Battle of Ankara": Bayezid captured after his breakout failed.

title.en: Timur dies at Otrar while preparing to invade Ming China, and his realm is divided among his heirs
title.es: Timur muere en Otrar mientras prepara la invasión de la China Ming, y su reino se reparte entre sus herederos
title.zh: 帖木儿在讹答剌病逝，当时正筹备入侵明朝，他的疆域由继承人分割

sources.citation: World History Encyclopedia, "Timur": died at Otrar on 19 February 1405 on his way to attack Ming China.
Encyclopedia.com, "Timur": fell ill and died in February 1405 on the way to conquer China.
Encyclopedia.com, "Empires: Timurid": the empire devolved into disunited dynasties after his death.

title.en: Ulugh Beg builds an observatory at Samarkand, where astronomers map about a thousand stars
title.es: Ulugh Beg construye un observatorio en Samarcanda, donde los astrónomos cartografían unas mil estrellas
title.zh: 兀鲁伯在撒马尔罕建造天文台，天文学家在此测绘约一千颗恒星

sources.citation: Luminet, Jean-Pierre (2018). "Ulugh Beg, Prince of Stars". arXiv:1804.08352: observatory started in 1424 and inaugurated in 1429.
Encyclopedia.com, "Ulugh-beg": observatory raised four years after the 1420 madrasa; star catalogue of 1,018 stars.

note.en: Luminet dates the start of work to 1424 and the inauguration to 1429. Encyclopedia.com has Ulugh Beg found his madrasa in 1420 and build the observatory four years later. His star catalogue lists 1,018 stars.
note.es: Luminet fecha el comienzo de las obras en 1424 y la inauguración en 1429. Encyclopedia.com cuenta que Ulugh Beg fundó su madrasa en 1420 y construyó el observatorio cuatro años después. Su catálogo estelar recoge 1018 estrellas.
note.zh: 吕米奈（Luminet）把动工定在1424年，落成启用定在1429年。Encyclopedia.com 称兀鲁伯1420年创办经学院，四年后建起天文台。他的星表载有1018颗恒星。

title.en: Shaybani Khan takes Herat, the Timurid capital in Khurasan, and Timurid rule there ends
title.es: Shaybani Jan toma Herat, la capital timúrida en Jorasán, y el dominio timúrida allí termina
title.zh: 昔班尼汗攻占帖木儿王朝在呼罗珊的都城赫拉特，王朝在当地的统治结束

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "Central Asia, Islam in": Shibani Khan seized the Timurid capital Herat in 1507.
EBSCO Research Starters, "Timurid Dynasty": Herat capitulated on 27 May 1507 after a three-day defence.

text.en: Timur took the title güregen, Mongolian for "royal son-in-law", because he had married a Genghisid princess.
text.es: Timur tomó el título de güregen, en mongol "yerno real", porque se había casado con una princesa chingisida.
text.zh: 帖木儿取了“古列干”（蒙古语“皇家女婿”）的称号，因为他娶了一位成吉思汗后裔的公主。

sources.citation: Encyclopedia.com, "Timur": by marrying a daughter of a former Chagatai khan he claimed a link to Genghis; he used the title Kurgan, "son-in-law" of the khan.
Encyclopedia.com, "Empires: Timurid": associated with the khans only by marriage, as a guregen, or imperial son-in-law.
EBSCO Research Starters, "Tamerlane": the royal marriage added the honorific gurakan, son-in-law of the ruler's family.
